Melati No. 5, Banjarmasin',phone:'081234567890',cashier:'Ani',onboarded:true});const st=window.__store;const ps=st.getState().products;const day=864e5;for(let d=6;d>=0;d--){const n=3+((d*7)%5);for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const s=st.getState();s.addToCart(ps[(d+k)%ps.length],1+(k%2));s.addToCart(ps[(d*3+k+5)%ps.length],1);if(k===1&&d===0)s.setCart({customer:'Pak Budi'});const sale=s.checkout({method:['cash','qris','cash','transfer'][k%4],paid:200000,debt:(k===2&&d===1)});const t=Date.now()-d*day-(n-k)*3600e3*0.6;st.setState(x=>({sales:x.sales.map(y=>y.id===sale.id?{...y,date:t}:y)}));}}st.getState().saveFinance({type:'out',amount:150000,cat:'bahan',note:'Beli beras 10 kg',date:Date.now()-3600e3});st.getState().saveFinance({type:'out',amount:45000,cat:'gas',note:'Isi ulang gas 3 kg',date:Date.now()-7200e3});st.getState().saveFinance({type:'out',amount:300000,cat:'listrik',note:'Token listrik',date:Date.now()-2*day});st.getState().saveFinance({type:'in',amount:500000,cat:'pesanan',note:'Nasi kotak 25 porsi',date:Date.now()-day});st.setState(x=>({sales:[...x.sales].sort((a,b)=>b.date-a.date)}));})()
